title: Claude Code Alternatives in 2026: Cursor, Qodo & GitHub Copilot Compared
summary: Qodo-produced demo positioning Qodo as a Claude Code alternative for review, vs Cursor and Copilot on one repo.

assertions.quote: clot code is way more expensive ... it keeps on hitting the rate limit

verdicts.note: Rate-limit and cost complaints about Claude Code are common and real for heavy users, but competitors also cap usage; anecdotal, from a competitor's video.

assertions.quote: when it comes to coding review platforms and security reviews, Kod kind of wins

verdicts.note: Based on one vendor-run demo on one repo; no independent comparison supports or refutes it.

assertions.quote: It says that there are open AI key exposed

verdicts.note: AI reviewers do catch real defects missed by humans, though with notable false-positive rates; complement, not replacement.
